snapshot.title: Differentiated sell pricing: market (80%) vs contractor (120%)
snapshot.description: Economy doc specifies two distinct sell paths. Sell to market = 80% of base market price. Sell to contractor = ~120% of base market price (with affinity bonus on top). Current debrief has a single payout path with contractor bonus but no market/contractor pricing distinction.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Debrief shows two sell options: 'Sell to Market' and 'Sell to Contractor' (when on contract route)
Market sell yields 80% of base mineral value
Contractor sell yields ~120% of base mineral value (plus existing affinity bonus)
Survey route only shows 'Sell to Market' option
